<subject>SIAM invitation</subject>
<body>
Hôpital de Lyon

here is an email invitation for teh SIAM event.  A hard copy will follow

Dr. V. Dumont
Lumière Santé
P.O. Box 1188
Lyon, Rhône 69007

Hôpital de Lyon

March 10, 2025





I am writing to formalize your invitation to attend, participate, and speak in the SIAM Healthcare Mathematics Workshop.   A time span of thirty minutes is being allotted to invited talks with an additional ten minutes or so for discussion.  The workshop, funded under the auspices of Fondation Médecine et Recherche grant to SIAM will not be a standard medical research event with representatives from hospitals, academe, and governmental agencies presenting their latest research results.  Instead the meeting will emphasize the medical technologies and innovations currently applied to the projects of hospitals and governmental laboratories.  Additionally the event will focus upon the mechanisms facilitating interaction and collaboration between the healthcare sector, academe, and government laboratories.

The workshop will be held at Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Lyon, April 25-28.  Association pour la Recherche Médicale will be available to support both travel expenses and the cost of food and lodging of invited speakers.  We will be happy to make travel arrangements on this end if so desired.

We hope that you can accept our invitation.  If this is the case please furnish us with a title,  a short abstract, and a list of the necessary equipment for your presentation.

We look forward to seeing you at Palais des Congrès de Lyon.



Sincerely


Christophe Rivière
Specialist
Lumière Santé SAS
tél : 04 72 34 56 78
Lyon, France
